large_and_boundary.note: Truncated tail enclosures may be conservative; screens cannot authorize decisions.

scope: finite numerical cross-checks plus independent review of the statistical argument

statistical_review.composite_null: The conditional noncentral hypergeometric family is monotone in its odds ratio.
statistical_review.hoeffding: Both the selected and complementary samples have deviation cross/(n0+n1); the smaller sample gives a valid Hoeffding upper bound.
statistical_review.multiple_looks: Each of two directions at every predeclared look receives delta/(2L); union bound controls equality error by delta and each wrong direction by delta/2.
statistical_review.null_test: Conditional on total successes, equality gives a central hypergeometric distribution.
statistical_review.pilot: Condition on an independent pilot freezing the angle, allocation and entire finite look schedule, then integrate over that pilot.
statistical_review.power: True gap strictly exceeding safety threshold plus concentration margin implies potential final-look power >=1-beta. Earlier wrong stopping costs <=delta/2; a good-pilot event costs its failure probability.
statistical_review.required_assumptions: Independent stationary Bernoulli validation observations; validation counts exclude pilot; all look-specific sample sizes fixed conditional on pilot; known orientation of the target contrast.
statistical_review.tail_enclosure: Lower partial sum and decreasing-ratio geometric remainder enclose the conditional tail with outward arithmetic.
